ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Harmonious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Safe and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Safe Travel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Environmental and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
